cross_component: COLOR-AXIS DEFAULT DRIFT: `color="default"` / `color:'default'` is the family-wide neutral baseline (card.tsx:50, progress.tsx:40, select.tsx:66, progress-ring stories) — the rubric G3 explicitly flags `color="default"` as off-canonical (should be `neutral`). Individual agents flagged the axis on progress-ring/select/switch/toggle but nobody named the systemic `default`-vs-`neutral` collision that originates in Card.

GAP-MODEL DRIFT is family-wide, not per-component: dialog + alert-dialog + sheet + menubar all still use `space-y-*`/`space-x-*` in their compound Header/Footer/menubar parts while the rest of the layer moved to `gap-*`. Only dialog (P3) and sheet (P2) were flagged; alert-dialog and menubar were missed. These header/footer blocks are literal clones of each other.

OVERLAY MOTION VOCABULARY SPLIT: overlays disagree on entrance/reduced-motion strategy. Dialog/AlertDialog/Sheet/Popover/Select/Combobox/Tooltip/HoverCard/DropdownMenu ALL rely on a consumer-mounted MotionConfig for reduced-motion with NO in-component guard (each flagged M3 individually). Separately, animation TECH is inconsistent: Menubar Content uses CSS keyframes but SubContent uses framer-motion; NavigationMenu uses a bespoke per-subcomponent MutationObserver bridge; Select/Combobox mount/unmount with no AnimatePresence exit while Dialog/Sheet animate exits. There is no single overlay-motion contract.

SELECTOR-FAMILY VARIANT DRIFT: Select has `variant`+`color` axes; Combobox has neither (flagged G4); Autocomplete has neither (flagged G3); SearchInput ships `xs` but docs claim `sm|md|lg`. The input/selector family does not share one variant/size/color vocabulary.

BOUNCE/OVERSHOOT-BY-DEFAULT is a layer-wide motion reflex: avatar badge (bouncy), badge-indicator (M1), color-input swatches (M1), radio dot (M1), progress fill (springs.smooth overshoot), stat-card delta arrow (M1), toast/toaster icon entrances (M1), dropdown-menu (springs.snappy overshoot), and `springs.bouncy` is shipped as a NAMED system token (lib P3). The default easing personality of the layer overshoots; the Card bar wants overshoot only where it means something.

RE-ROLL-INSTEAD-OF-COMPOSE is systemic (F5): autocomplete/number-input/color-input re-roll Input; alert-dialog/split-button re-roll Button; charts/data-table-card/file-upload/toaster re-roll Card surface; skeleton sub-components re-roll Skeleton; stat-flash duplicates StatCard's chip surface VERBATIM (drift pair). The layer repeatedly rebuilds base primitives instead of composing them.

CONTROLLED-ONLY / NON-CANONICAL HANDLERS: autocomplete, combobox, color-input, number-input, pagination, segmented-control, split-button, stepper, tree-view all ship controlled-only APIs with no `defaultValue`/uncontrolled mode, and several use non-canonical handler names (`onChange(value)` instead of `onValueChange`, `onSelect`, `selectedId`). No shared controlled/uncontrolled contract across interactive components.

BESPOKE-CORNER-PROP over slot (F1) recurs: avatar `badge`, badge dot/icons, banner `actions`, breadcrumb `separator`, button start/endIcon, chat scrollToBottomSlot, combobox renderOption, data-table emptyState/renderExpanded/bulkActions, popover `title`, progress-ring showValue, split-button dropdownContent, stat-card icon/footer/delta, status-dot label, stepper Step props, tree-view actions/secondaryLabel. The layer defaults to corner-injection props rather than the Card-style slot model.

TOUCH-TARGET < 44px recurs across interactive components: segmented-control (28/32/40), pagination (36), dialog close (24), banner dismiss (24), color-swatch copy, tree-view rows, textarea `xs`, badge-group overflow pill. No shared enforcement of the 44px minimum.

FORCED-COLORS / RTL / reduced-motion STATE COVERAGE is near-universally absent from stories+tests across the layer (flagged individually on ~30 components). This is a systemic story/test convention gap, not isolated.

cross_component: DOMINANT THEME — F5 re-roll (18 of 30 components, ~60%): content-card, error-boundary, loading-skeleton, page-skeletons, file-preview, activity-feed, status-badge, priority-indicator, avatar-group, date-picker, page-header, filter-bar, rich-chat-input, rich-text-editor, schedule-view, master-detail, extensions, global-loading all hand-roll a surface/button/badge/breadcrumb that a base primitive (Card, Button/IconButton, Badge, Breadcrumb, Avatar, Select) already owns. This is the exact StatCard-fixed drift and is the single largest gap between this layer and the Card bar. It is not 18 isolated bugs — it is one systemic 'compose the primitive' discipline the layer never adopted.

F6 controlled/uncontrolled gap (15 of 30, 50%): avatar-group, activity-feed, confirm-dialog, bulk-action-bar, date-picker, emoji-picker, form-section, filter-bar, multi-select-popover, member-picker, master-detail, inline-edit, rich-text-editor, rich-chat-input, simple-tooltip. Repeated pattern: supports `value`/controlled `open` but no `defaultValue`/`defaultOpen`; several fire `onChange`/`onSave`/`onSelect(id)` (DOM/bespoke semantics) where the DS convention is `onValueChange`. The layer has no shared controlled/uncontrolled hook, so every author reinvented it and half got it wrong.

Non-canonical CVA variant axes diverge across siblings: content-card uses `padding: default|compact|spacious|none`; priority-indicator uses `display: compact|full` (a dead axis); filter-bar uses `size: xs|sm|md`; status-badge bakes semantics into a `status` axis; file-preview VolumeControl uses `variant: light|dark`; bulk-action-bar & confirm-dialog truncate `color` to `accent|error`. No two of these share the canonical variant/size/color taxonomy — there is no single sizing/color vocabulary across the layer.

Surface-token vocabulary is inconsistent within families: extensions' three suggestion popovers use two different overlay shadows (`shadow-raised-hover` vs `shadow-floating`) and two active-row tints; content-card's `outline` uses `border-surface-border` while sibling Card uses `border-surface-border-strong` (G4); loading-skeleton/page-skeletons pick `rounded-overlay-lg` (Dialog radius) for card tiles instead of `rounded-surface` (Card radius); error-boundary uses `rounded-overlay-lg`+`p-ds-07` unlike Card's `rounded-surface`. Card tiles across the skeleton family are border-led (double-edge) while the real Card default is elevation-led — a V2 mismatch repeated in 3+ components.

`uppercase tracking-wider` all-caps section/group headers (V14) recur as the default label treatment in at least 5 components: activity-feed.tsx:278, command-palette.tsx:416, date-picker calendar-grid.tsx:240 + time-picker headers, extensions slash-command group labels. Each is individually defensible but collectively it is the layer's reflexive eyebrow-kicker pattern — no shared decision, just repeated reach.

Infinite decorative pulse (`repeat: Infinity`) as a motion vocabulary: deadline-indicator, schedule-view now-indicator, priority-indicator URGENT (×2), rich-chat-input recording-overlay (×2), empty-state icon bob — 7 loops across 5 components, all at hardcoded 2s/3s/500ms/1s, and only empty-state guards reduced-motion (and even it left its text-fade unguarded). No shared idle-loop preset; reduced-motion coverage is per-author and mostly missing.

Story/doc examples repeatedly model actions with raw hand-styled `<button style={{background:'#D33163'|'#22c55e'|'#6366F1'}}>` inline instead of the DS `<Button variant="soft">`: content-card.stories, empty-state.stories, page-header stories, rich-chat-input story fixtures, file-preview fixtures. The canonical examples teach the anti-pattern the components exist to prevent — a layer-wide story-hygiene gap, not one file's slip.

Per-component docs drift from source across the layer: command-palette ('fuzzy' vs substring + 7 missing props), deadline-indicator ('doesn't live-update' — it does, every 60s), priority-indicator (LOW color), avatar-group (indicator color), page-header ('renders Breadcrumb internally' — it doesn't), status-badge ('built on ui/Badge' — it isn't), page-skeletons ('built on LoadingSkeleton' — it imports ui/Skeleton), global-loading ('auto-unmounts' — false), member-picker/rich-chat-input stale prop tables, emoji-picker/deadline-indicator missing props. ~10 docs assert behavior the source contradicts.
